content: Remove the cable sleeve completely from the cable and use the textile sleeve tool to insert both the cable and nylon string into the sleeve.

I found it much easier to insert the nylon end into the extruder, then start to run it into the sleeve a few cm.  Install the back cover, then run the nylon into the remaining cable.  It was super hard to get the orientation right - note the "end pointing down" depends on what direction your connector is pointing and its easy to get it wrong.

Use the ball-end of an M2.0 or M2.5 hex driver to guide the sleeve opening. Once the cables and nylon string are inside, run the ball-end of the hex driver along the other side of the cable/nylon string bundle to make sure the sleeve isn't folded over on itself and wraps the correct way. Avoid using anything sharp or you will poke through the sleeve.
why didn't the bundle come with the nylon???  This was another massive pain...
